title: Northbeam TechWorks Service Hours and Surcharge Percentages
content:
Every TechWorks service has ordinary hours of its own, and work outside them or at a weekend carries a surcharge expressed as a percentage. This notice of the Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair scheduling office records, for each service, its ordinary service hours, the surcharge percentage carried on labour outside those hours, and the surcharge percentage carried on labour on a Saturday or a Sunday.

| TechWorks service | Ordinary service hours | Outside ordinary hours, percent | Saturday or Sunday, percent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | store trading hours | 0 | 0 |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | eight in the morning to six in the evening, Monday to Saturday | 25 | 15 |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | nine in the morning to eight in the evening, Tuesday to Sunday | 35 | 25 |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | seven in the morning to five in the afternoon, Monday to Saturday | 25 | 15 |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | seven in the morning to seven in the evening, Monday to Friday | 40 | 30 |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | around the clock for covered incidents | 20 | 10 |

## Points of judgement on the figures

**A bench job carries neither percentage.** Work handled at the store counter is worked within store trading hours, and both of its surcharge percentages stand at 0.

**The two percentages are never equal where they are carried at all.** On each of the five services that carry them, the percentage outside ordinary hours stands above the weekend percentage: 25 against 15 on the standard home installation service and on the appliance service, 35 against 25 on the calibration service, 40 against 30 on the business deployment service, and 20 against 10 on the annual care service.

**Ordinary hours are not the same week for every service.** The calibration service works Tuesday to Sunday, the business deployment service Monday to Friday, the standard home installation and appliance services Monday to Saturday, and the annual care service stands ready around the clock for covered incidents.
